subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers require a repaired, rebased Feishu PR with live CardKit proof, or apply a proof override after sanctioned maintainer verification?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek streaming setup, while ClawSweeper cannot treat helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient proof for a Feishu-visible message-delivery change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override After Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap after verifying the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accepting the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch only if maintainers want the latest-token case handled by a broader Feishu streaming-card reliability PR.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee and recently touched the Feishu streaming-card module, making them the best available owner for proof override or branch disposition.
